name: Assalah
description: The lively core of Dahab strung along the seafront promenade, packed with dive centres, cafes, restaurants and shops. It has the most amenities and social scene, and its Masbat area is the busiest, most walkable part of town.
bestFor: Nomads wanting cafes, dive shops, coworking and an active social scene

name: Mashraba
description: The southern stretch of the seafront, more laid-back than Assalah but still lined with hotels, camps and restaurants. It sits close to the Islands dive site and offers a calmer base while remaining an easy walk from the main promenade.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet, cheaper camps within walking distance of town

name: Lighthouse
description: A central seafront area named for its lighthouse and popular house reef, right by the water. It has beach camps, cafes and easy shore access to snorkelling and diving, sitting between the busier Masbat and quieter southern stretches.
bestFor: Divers and snorkellers wanting reef access steps from their door

name: Dahab City
tagline: Local inland residential and services area
description: The inland part of town away from the seafront, where many locals live and where you find the bus station, supermarkets, banks and cheaper long-term rentals. It is less scenic but practical for extended stays and everyday errands.
bestFor: Budget long-stayers wanting cheaper rent and everyday local services
